title: RNA extraction from Synechocystis sp. PCC 6803 with Trizol reagent
author: Dennis DD Dienst
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j3scqne

steps.title: Prepare Tubes and Cooling
steps.instruction: Label all required tubes and store them on ice or in the freezer. Fill a sterile 50 mL Falcon tube with ice and place it in an ice bath.

steps.title: Harvest Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Harvest the Synechocystis sp. PCC 6803 cell culture, ensuring minimal transport time before harvest.

substeps.instruction: Pour 20-25 mL of cell culture (OD750 < 1.0) into the ice-filled 50 mL tube up to the ~45 mL mark
Centrifuge at 4000 - 5000 g and 4 °C for 5 min
Discard the supernatant into a large beaker

steps.title: Concentrate Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Concentrate the cells using a secondary spin on ice.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in the residual water (~1 mL)
Transfer the suspension into 2 mL safe-lock tubes
Centrifuge at ~13,000 g and 4 °C for 15 sec
Remove the supernatant as quantitatively as possible using a pipette

steps.title: Lysis and RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Lyse the cells using Trizol reagent and perform initial phase separation.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL Trizol reagent
Store at -20 °C or -80 °C
Incubate frozen samples at 65 °C for 15 min under constant agitation (or vortex once per minute if no shaking thermoblock is available)
Add 200 µL ice-cold chloroform-isoamylalcohol (24:1) per 1 mL Trizol and vortex for 30 sec
Centrifuge at ~11,000 g and 4 °C for 10 min
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a fresh 1.5 mL tube

steps.title: Secondary Phase Purification
steps.instruction: Further purify the aqueous phase using phenol-chloroform-isoamylalcohol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume of ice-cold phenol-chloroform-isoamylalcohol (25:24:1), ensuring the phenol solution is not Tris-buffered
Centrifuge (implied by context of phase separation)
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a fresh 1.5 mL tube

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA from the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume of isopropanol (2-propanol), 10 µL 3 M Na-Acetate (pH 5.2), and 1 µL RNA-grade glycogen (Thermo)
Incubate overnight at -20 °C
Centrifuge at ~13,000 g and 4 °C for 30 min

steps.title: RNA Pellet Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and wash the pellet with ice-cold 70% EtOH
Centrifuge at ~13,000 g and 4 °C for 10 min
Repeat the wash and centrifugation step once more

steps.title: Final Recovery and Storage
steps.instruction: Dry and resuspend the final RNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and air-dry the RNA pellet for ~10 min
Resuspend the RNA pellet in ~30 µL ultra-pure water
Store at -20 °C or -80 °C
